data.name: The Dark World: Edge of Eternity
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

The Dark World: Edge of Eternity is a modern gothic survival RPG set in Panonia, a cursed land where ancient bloodlines never truly died. Beneath ruined cities, frozen strongholds, abandoned villages, and forests drowned in fog, something old is waking again. Vampires, werewolves, witches, and humans are locked in a relentless struggle for survival, territory, and power while the world descends deeper into chaos.

Explore a hostile open world shaped by war, myth, and the collapse of faith. Scavenge for supplies, build your shelter, craft weapons and equipment, and fight to endure a land where safety is temporary and every road can lead to violence, hunger, or something far worse. The world of Panonia is as unforgiving as the creatures that rule it, and survival demands more than brute force. It demands preparation, adaptation, and the will to keep moving when everything around you is falling apart.

Choose your path through a world torn between humanity and monstrosity. Defend what remains of mankind, embrace the curse that runs through ancient blood, or forge your own place between the powers haunting the dark. Whether you face the nightmare alone or survive it with others in multiplayer, every decision pulls you deeper into a conflict older than memory.

At the center of this darkness lies the Book of Blood, a cursed relic tied to the hidden origins of Panonia’s nightmare. What begins as a fight to survive soon becomes a descent into forbidden history, fractured truth, and the force stirring behind the fall of the world. The deeper you go, the more the line between salvation and corruption disappears.

In The Dark World: Edge of Eternity, survival is only the beginning. Beyond the ruins, beyond the factions, beyond the bloodshed, something ancient waits to be remembered.

KEY FEATURES

  • Explore a modern gothic open world set in the cursed land of Panonia

  • Survive through scavenging, crafting, building, and combat in a hostile environment

  • Face deadly enemies, dynamic weather, and shifting territorial dangers

  • Develop your character through progression, combat-driven gameplay, and survival choices

  • Step into a world shaped by Humans, Vampires, Werewolves, and Witches, with deeper race paths expanding through future updates

  • Uncover the secrets of the Book of Blood, a relic tied to the origins of the world’s darkness

  • Play solo or in multiplayer, and fight for survival in a land ruled by fear, hunger, and ancient power

SURVIVE THE NIGHT

Scavenge ruined settlements, gather resources, craft essential gear, and build shelter in a world where the night is never empty. Every expedition is a risk, every encounter can turn fatal, and every mistake can drag you deeper into the dark.

BUILD, CRAFT, ENDURE

Create the tools you need to survive. Fortify your shelter, prepare for the dangers ahead, and adapt to a world where resources are scarce and death is always close.

CHOOSE YOUR PATH

Panonia is shaped by conflict between Humans, Vampires, Werewolves, and Witches. As the world evolves through future updates, new ways to experience that struggle will emerge, opening deeper paths into the war for the future of the land.

UNCOVER THE BOOK OF BLOOD

Follow the trail of a cursed relic linked to the hidden origins of the world’s collapse. What it reveals may explain the darkness consuming Panonia, but some truths are more dangerous than monsters.

ENTER THE DARK WORLD

Play alone or with others in multiplayer and carve your place in a land where blood remembers, faith is broken, and survival comes at a cost.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or DirectX 12 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 35 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 35 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
The Dark World: Edge of Eternity contains mature content that may not be appropriate for all players. This includes violence, blood, gore, disturbing imagery, horror themes, and intense supernatural elements.

The game also explores dark themes such as death, corruption, cruelty, survival, and psychological fear. Certain environments, enemy designs, and narrative moments are intended to be unsettling or disturbing.
